description: This file is a documentation outline with embedded code snippet in PHP that demonstrates a class 'Zip' for handling ZIP archive creation with a custom Content-Length header workaround.

classes.name: Zip
classes.description: A PHP class that manages ZIP archive creation with a workaround for adding a Content-Length header based on an estimated size, assuming all file contents are known beforehand and deflate compression is disabled.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the archive with a given name.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a file with name and data to the archive.

methods.name: addFileFromPath
methods.description: Adds a file from the filesystem to the archive by specifying its path.

methods.name: getEstimate
methods.description: Calculates an approximate total size of the ZIP archive contents based on the files added.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Outputs the Content-Length header with an estimated size, then creates and outputs the ZIP archive, finalizing with a call to 'finish()' on the ZipStream object, and exits.
